why: Where a check deliberately leaves something alone: the files, lines, packages or names it skips, one list per check, every entry with the reason it is excepted. Read through scripts/lib/exceptions.mjs. These lists stay apart from the retirement list's allowed places (design-system/agent-views/_inventions.json), which record where an old name may stay, and from the baselines, which record a count that may only fall. An entry says WHY, so one that has outlived its reason is easy to see and delete.
